description.en: Sejun, your average Seoul underdog, didn’t expect to grow tomatoes full-time when he stumbled into the mysterious dungeon full of monster quests and extravagant rewards. Yet, there he was, as a farmer growing and selling cash crops while clearing numerous quests that came his way. Will Sejun make it out of the dungeon with the plush rewards he hoped for? At least he has what it takes: optimism, resourcefulness, and a group of loyal furry friends.
description.it: Un giorno, una misteriosa torre apparve improvvisamente in città. La gente decise di chiamarla dungeon, e sebbene fosse pieno di asperità e mostri pericolosi, era anche una terra di opportunità, dove erano in attesa innumerevoli tesori. Quando Sejun, un giovane che vive una vita normale, viene invitato per caso nel dungeon sotterraneo, è entusiasta all'idea di diventare ricco, ma è rimasto bloccato in una zona nascosta della torre misteriosa. Tutto quello che ha sono alcuni semi e il suo corpo. Ora Sejun deve coltivare, raccogliere risorse e capire come sopravvivere!
description.es-la: Un día, una torre misteriosa apareció de repente en la ciudad. La gente decidió llamarla mazmorra, y aunque estaba llena de un terreno irregular y monstruos peligrosos, también era una tierra de oportunidades, donde aguardaban innumerables tesoros. Cuando Sejun, un joven que vive una vida ordinaria, es invitado por casualidad a la mazmorra, está emocionado ante la perspectiva de hacerse rico, pero se encuentra varado en un área oculta de la misteriosa torre. Todo lo que tiene son unas pocas semillas y su cuerpo. ¡Ahora, Sejun debe cultivar, recolectar recursos y descubrir su propia estrategia de supervivencia!
description.pt-br: Sejun, o típico azarão de Seul não esperava se tornar um Fazendeiro quando tropeçou e foi transportado para a famosa Dungeon, cheia de missões, de monstros e recompensas misteriosas. No entanto, lá estava ele, como um agricultor cultivando e vendendo seus frutos engenhosamente, enquanto concluía inúmeras missões que surgiam em seu caminho. Será que Sejun conseguirá sair da Dungeon que está preso? Pelo menos ele tem o que é necessário: otimismo, engenhosidade e um grupo de leais amigos peludinhos.

description.en:
Lilian McKellion, the girl who wanted to avoid a bad end, willingly went to the insomniac emperor in place of her sister, Laelin. She is tasked to help the sleepless emperor, who was cursed by a witch, by using her ability to induce sleep whenever she touches another person's body with her lips. Can Lilian survive being with the emperor, ‘Kael Rue Kaldorf?'

---
Reincarnated as the illegitimate daughter of Duke McKellion, Lilian was never fully embraced by her father or society. So, when she has the opportunity to take her sister’s place in an arranged marriage to Emperor Kael Lu Kaldorf, Lilian jumps at the chance. 

The only problem is, her prospective partner gets cranky without his sleep, and since being cursed by a vindictive witch, the tyrannical emperor hasn’t experienced a single moment of slumber. 

But that’s no challenge for Lilian, who possesses the ability to induce sleep with a kiss. Now, tasked with the duty of keeping His Majesty well-rested, Lilian must kiss the emperor each night to keep his temper at bay. It’s a simple contractual agreement, and Lilian has no plans to develop romantic feelings, but what happens when Kael unexpectedly falls for her?

---

description.es: Lilian McKelion acude al emperador que sufre de insomnio en reemplazo de su hermana Leilan para evitar un final trágico. Asumirá la responsabilidad de entretener al emperador cuando él no pueda dormir por culpa de la maldición de una bruja, aprovechando su capacidad de hacer dormir cuando sus labios tocan el cuerpo de la otra persona. ¿Podrá Lilian sobrevivir de las garras del emperador, Kael Lou Kaldorf?
description.fr: Dans ce roman, je me suis retrouvée dans le corps de Lilian, la fille illégitime du duc McKellion, rejetée par son père et par la société. Consciente du sort tragique qui attend la famille McKellion, j'ai décidé de protéger ma sœur et d'épouser l'empereur Kael Lu Kaldorf à sa place. Ce dernier fut maudit par une sorcière quelques années auparavant, et est à présent incapable de dormir sans la magie des dames de la maison McKellion. Afin de l'empêcher de devenir un tyran assoiffé de sang à cause de son manque de sommeil constant, je n'ai pas d'autre choix que de rester à ses côtés, utilisant ma magie pour l'endormir chaque soir à l'aide d'un baiser. Cette union platonique n'était motivée que par nos intérêts respectifs... mais... que se passerait-il si l'empereur venait à tomber amoureux?
description.id: Setelah membaca sebuah novel, Lilian masuk ke dalam novel dan berupaya mengubah takdir kehancuran keluarga McKellion. Lilian dan Reilan McKellion adalah wanita keturunan kerajaan McKellion yang mampu membuat seseorang tertidur dengan kekuatan yang sudah diwariskan secara turun temurun. Untuk menghindari nasib buruk, Lilian rela pergi ke Istana untuk menggantikan kakaknya, Reilan McKellion, membantu sang Raja. Tugas Lilian adalah membuat Raja Kael yang tidak pernah tidur akibat dikutuk oleh seorang penyihir, tertidur dengan kekuatannya.
description.ja: バッドエンドを避けるために姉のレリアンの代わりに不眠症の皇帝の所に行くことにした「リリアン·メッケリオン」。 相手の身体に唇が触れると眠らせてしまう能力を持っているリリアンは魔女の呪いによって一日も眠ることができなくなった皇帝に安眠を約束する責務を負うことになる。果たしてリリアンは皇帝「カエル・ル・カルドルプ」から無事に生還することができるのか？

description.zh: 为了避免死亡的结局，她代替姐姐雷兰去了失眠的皇帝那里，利用嘴唇接触到对方身体来帮助皇帝进入睡眠。因为魔女的诅咒长期失眠的皇帝，一直暴躁地生活着。而她能否从暴君皇帝手中安然无恙地活下来呢?

description.de: Nach einer folgenschweren Schlacht gegen Riesen, in der es um das Schicksal der Welt geht, geht Ronan als letzter Mann der kaiserlichen Armee als Sieger hervor. Doch während er an der Seite seiner sterbenden Befehlshaberin, Großmarschallin Adeshan, steht, wird schnell klar: Der Kampf gegen die Riesen war erst der Anfang. Adeshan, die in dem mutigen Ronan die einzige Hoffnung für die Menschheit sieht, nutzt ihre letzte Chance auf eine Rückkehr in die Vergangenheit, um ihn 10 Jahre zurück zu schicken. Nun gilt es für Ronan, sich an der angesehenen Phileon-Akademie einzuschreiben und der stärkste Schwertkämpfer zu werden, den das Kaiserreich je gesehen hat!
description.en:
Following a momentous battle against giants for the fate of the world, Ronan emerges victorious as the last man standing of the Imperial Army. As he laments this hollow victory with his dying commander, Grand Marshal Adeshan, they quickly learn that the war is far from over and an overwhelming force of giants descends from the heavens.

Fearing the worst, yet seeing hope in the courageous Ronan, Adeshan uses her last time slip to send him back to the past, so that he can enroll in the prestigious Phileon Academy and become the strongest swordsman the empire has ever seen!
description.fr: Grièvement blessé après un combat épique contre trois géants, Ronan, l'un des rares survivants de l'armée impériale, partage une victoire amère avec sa commandante, la générale Adéchan. Leur soulagement est de courte durée quand une nouvelle menace apparaît à l'horizon : une armée de géants se profile dans le ciel. Craignant le pire, Adéchan, fondant son espoir sur Ronan, utilise son ultime recours : Un voyage temporel. Elle renvoie son subordonné dans le passé, lui offrant une chance de s'inscrire à l'académie impériale Philéon, où il devra se forger en épéiste prodige que l'empire ait jamais connu pour préserver son avenir.
description.id: Setelah berhasil mengalahkan raksasa Ahayute, Ronan bersiap menyambut kematian dengan tubuhnya yang melemah. Namun di saat-saat terakhirnya, muncul 'delapan sayap' yang menginvasi bumi. Sebelum Ronan sempat bertarung melawan makhluk tersebut, suatu hal terjadi yang membuat ia kembali ke masa remajanya–sekitar 10 tahun sebelum monster dan raksasa mendatangi bumi. Berbekal ingatan dan keahlian pedangnya, Ronan mulai mempersiapkan diri untuk peperangan yang akan terjadi di masa depan.
description.it: Dopo una battaglia epocale contro i giganti per il destino del mondo, Ronan emerge vittorioso come l'ultimo uomo rimasto in piedi dell'esercito imperiale. Mentre si lamenta di questa vittoria vuota con il suo comandante morente, il Gran Maresciallo Adeshan, apprendono rapidamente che la guerra è tutt'altro che finita e una schiacciante forza di giganti scende dai cieli. Temendo il peggio, ma vedendo speranza nel coraggioso Ronan, Adeshan usa il suo ultimo lapsus temporale per rimandarlo nel passato, così che possa iscriversi alla prestigiosa Accademia Phileon e diventare lo spadaccino più forte che l'impero abbia mai visto!
description.ja: 後悔したまま終わってしまったロナンの人生。しかし偶然訪れた二度目のチャンス。 世界を救うための冒険が今、始まる。
description.ko: 후회로 점철된 채 끝나버린 삶. 우연히 찾아온 두 번째 기회. 세상을 구하기 위한 로난의 모험이 시작된다.
description.zh:
最后一次的重生机会
这次能否拯救世界？
与巨人战斗身受重伤，拥有斩杀巨人能力的罗南却感觉人生很失败，最后的愿望是如果能活下去一定要去学院学习。随着更多更高级的巨人登场，已经是最后时刻的罗南仍不愿放弃战斗，被拥有重生能力的大将军赋予了仅剩最后一次的重生机会。这次他的愿望能实现吗？

description.en:
When Lee Shana accidentally crossed into another world full of fantasy and beauty, sadly she had become a witch in the midst of an execution. Dying at such a wonderful age?! She couldn't let that happen! She had to escape no matter what! But after her escape she offended none other than the crown prince Luther! What else could go wrong?

---
Sana, an ordinary Korean woman, gets transported to another dimension and finds herself in the body of Isana in Titan Empire, a daughter of Count Castilla. She soon learns that she has a secret - not only is she a royalty in this Empire, but she is also a witch with great powers. A chance encounter with vn Prince Ludwig takes Sana on an unexpected journey to combat the evil Duke Barbossa as she navigates this new world to find her way back home...

description.en: Jieum Ban has an extraordinary ability: she can remember the memories of all her past lives. After her previous life is cut short by a tragic accident, she sets out to reconnect with the people of her past life in her current one. Will memories of her 18th life sabotage romance in her 19th? Or will love endure across different lives?
description.es:
Jieum Ban tiene una habilidad extraordinaria: puede recordar todas sus vidas pasadas. Sabe que la última, la número 18, terminó a causa de un trágico accidente. Cuando reencarna en la número 19, quiere volver a vincularse con las personas de su vida anterior, pero ¿los recuerdos terminarán saboteando el romance de su vida actual? ¿O el amor puede resistir y perdurar de una vida a la otra?

description.en:
Lee Myung-jun, the Vice Chairman of Hyundo Group, lost his daughter to a group of bullies. Seeking revenge, he adopts Yoon Karma, a psychopathic defector girl.

Yoon Karma: A sadistic human weapon created through drug experiments in North Korea. After killing everyone in the research lab, she escaped to South Korea on her own.

Having just been released from a juvenile detention center in South Korea, Yoon Karma sets out to hunt down the bullies at school, driven by the desire to avenge her new father and satisfy her sadistic pleasures.
description.pt-br:
Lee Myung-jun, o vice-presidente do grupo Hyundo, perdeu sua filha para um grupo de pessoas que faziam bullying. Buscando vingança, ele adota Yoon Karma, uma garota desertora psicopata.
Yoon Karma: Uma arma humana sádica criada por meio de experimentos com drogas na Coreia do Norte. Depois de matar todos no laboratório de pesquisa, ela escapou para a Coreia do Sul sozinha.
Tendo acabado de ser libertada de um centro de detenção juvenil na Coreia do Sul, Yoon Karma sai para caçar os valentões na escola, movida pelo desejo de vingar seu novo pai e satisfazer seus prazeres sádicos.

description.de: Der einzigartige Kampfkünstler und stolze Herrscher der Dämonensekte, Mookhyang, landet durch einen Fluch der gegnerischen Blutsekte in einer geheimnisvollen Fantasy-Welt. Doch wenn herauskommt, welch unglaubliche Kontrolle Mookhyang über Qi oder Mana hat, ist es nur eine Frage der Zeit, bis er erneut verflucht wird ... und sich in eine junge Frau verwandelt!? Wird die Macht über chinesische Kampfkunst in dieser Welt der Elfen, Magier und Drachen ausreichen, damit ein Mann (oder eine Frau) wieder nach Hause zurückkehren kann? Oder wird dieser arme Krieger letztendlich eine Niederlage erleiden?
description.en:
The exceptional martial artist and proud hierarch of the Demonic Sect, Mookhyang, winds up in a strange new fantasy realm after falling victim to a curse cast by his enemies, the Blood Sect. But when Mookhyang’s incredible control over qi, or mana, becomes known, it’s only a matter of time before he gets cursed again… and turned into a young lady?! 

In this world of elves, mages, knights, and dragons, will a mastery of Chinese martial arts be enough for one man (or woman) to fight his way back home? Or will this humbled warrior finally concede defeat?

description.fr: Mookhyang, pratiquant des arts martiaux et hiérarche de la Secte Démoniaque, se retrouve plongé dans un univers fantastique après avoir été victime d'une malédiction de la part de son ennemi, la Secte du Sang. Mais lorsque les capacités de contrôle du Qi (ou « mana ») de Mookhyang sont révélées au grand jour, ce dernier se retrouve bientôt à nouveau maudit... et transformé en... jeune fille ! Dans cet univers où vivent elfes, mages, chevaliers et dragons, la maîtrise des art martiaux chinois suffira-t-elle à un homme (ou à une « femme » ? ) pour survivre et retrouver le chemin vers un monde ordinaire ? Ou bien cet humble guerrier déclarera-t-il forfait ?
description.ja: 千年に一人の達人「脱魔」の域に達した魔教の教主、墨香。 しかし武林の支配を目論む張仁傑の怪しげな術により異なる世界へ飛ばされてしまう。 言葉も文化も分からない世界で、墨香の孤独な戦いが幕を開ける。
description.ko:
마교의 교주로서 극강의 무공을 자랑하던 묵향은 적들(혈교)에 의해 생전 처음 보는 생소한 이세계(판타지 세계)로 떨어지게 된다. 그곳에서 엘프, 마법사, 기사, 드래곤 등 새로운 존재들과 만나며... 무림 최고수 묵향이 원래 자신의 세상(무림)으로 돌아가기 위해 긴 모험을 떠나게 된다는 스토리.

한국의 무협소설과 판타지 문학을 사랑하는 수많은 독자들이 기다려왔던 초대형 이벤트― 웹툰계를 뒤흔들 다시없을 프로젝트가 시작된다! 
1999년부터 시작된 전설, 누계부수 300만부... 무협소설과 판타지문학을 접목시킨 기념비적인 장르소설인 [묵향]이 드디어 만화화!! 

한국 무협판타지의 한 획을 그었던 전동조 작가의 메가히트 장르소설 [묵향]을 만화화! 만화의 내용은 원작의 2부격인 [다크레이디] 편에서부터 시작한다.

description.zh: 魔教教主墨香在经历脱胎换骨之后，修道成仙。 却在即将称霸武林之际遭人谋算，被移送至了精灵、魔法师、骑士、龙等生物共存的异世界里，墨香为了重回原来的世界，开始了冒险之旅！
description.pt-br: MookHyang, o mestre da Escola das Artes Profanas e o invencível Demônio Exposto, é infelizmente enviado a um mundo de fantasia estranho pela magia de seus inimigos da Escola das Artes de Sangue. Em um novo mundo com elfos, feiticeiros, cavaleiros e dragões, a aventura de MookHyang em busca de um meio para voltar ao seu velho mundo (Murim) tem início.
description.zh-hk:
身懷絕世武功的魔教教主墨香，被來自血教的敵人
送往生平從未見過的陌生異域(奇幻世界)。
在那裡，他遇上了精靈、魔法師、騎士、龍族...等
前所未聞的人事物。
為了回到原本的世界(武林)，
武林第一人墨香踏上旅程，一場大冒險就此展開!

喜愛韓國武俠小說與奇幻文學的讀者
引頸期盼的超大型活動!
震撼Webtoon界的絕倫企劃正式啟動!
1999年開始連載的傳說之作、累積銷量高達300萬冊...
結合武俠與奇幻的劃時代小說「墨香」，終於漫畫化!!

為韓國奇幻武俠立下全新里程碑的大師級作家
JEON DongZo精心打造的超高人氣小說「墨香」，
終於漫畫化啦!!

漫畫內容由原著第二部《Dark Lady》開展。

title.en: The Descent of the Demonic Master

description.en:
The first life: After a tragic accident losing his family and legs, he ends his own life.

The second life: He earned fame as the Red Demonic Master in Zhongyuan, but was betrayed by the man he trusted the most.

And now comes his third life. In his life back in the modern world, Gang Jinho decides to live a normal life. However, he was too used to the Zhongyuan life to become a normal person!

"I wanted to live peacefully. But you are the ones who started it. I hope you're prepared for this."

In front of the threats of his new life, can Gang Jinho shake off his impulses as the Red Demonic Master and obtain the 'normal life' he desires? The adaptation story of a legendary martial artist in the 21st century!
description.pl: Jego pierwsze życie zakończyło się szybko i tragicznie. W drugim został Demonicznym Mistrzem, lecz przez to narobił sobie wrogów i został zabity w młodym wieku. Po drugiej śmierci powrócił do swojego pierwotnego świata, do czasu przed wypadkiem i przed jego tragicznym życiem kaleki. Postanowił, że teraz zrobi co w jego mocy, by żyć spokojnie i szczęśliwie.
description.ru: Первая жизнь. После трагического несчастного случая, потеряв свою семью и ноги, он заканчивает свою собственную жизнь. Вторая жизнь. Он заслужил славу Красного демонического мастера в Чжунъюане, но был предан человеком, которому доверял больше всего. И вот наступает его третья жизнь. В своей жизни, вернувшись в современный мир, Ган Цзиньхо решает жить нормальной жизнью… Однако он слишком привык к жизни Чжунъюаня, чтобы стать нормальным человеком! -Я хотел жить спокойно. Но ведь это вы все начали. Надеюсь, вы к этому готовы."Перед лицом угроз его новой жизни, может Ли Ган Джинхо стряхнуть свои импульсы как красный демонический Мастер и получить "нормальную жизнь", которую он желает?
description.tr:
İlk hayatında, trajik bir kazanın ardından hem ayaklarını hemde ailesini kaybedince kendi hayatını sonlandırdı. İkinci hayatında, Zhongyuan‘da Kızıl Şeytani Egemen olarak şan ve şöhret kazandı. Lakin en güvendiği kişi tarafından ihanete uğradı. Ardından üçüncü hayatında ise modern dünyadaki yaşamına geri döndü ve Gang Jinho normal bir hayat yaşamaya karar verdi…. ama normal bir şekilde yaşayabilmek için Zhongyuan‘daki hayatına çok alışmıştı! “huzurlu bir şekilde yaşamak istemiştim, bunu siz başlattınız. umarım kendinizi hazırlamışsınızdır.” yeni hayatının tehditleri karşısında Gang Jinho, Kızıl Şeytani Egemenin dürtülerini yakasından atıp dilediği gibi “normal bir hayat” sürebilecek mi?  
  
[Official French on Delitoon](https://delitoon.com/webtoon/return-of-the-demonic-master)
description.pt-br: Primeira vida. Depois de um trágico acidente perdendo sua família e suas pernas, ele comete suicídio. Segunda vida. Ganhou fama como o Mestre Demoníaco Vermelho em Zhongyuan, mas foi traído pelo homem em quem mais confiava. E agora vem sua terceira vida. Uma nova vida no mundo moderno, Gang Jinho decide vivê-la normalmente… No entanto, ele estava muito acostumado com a vida em Zhongyuan para se tornar uma pessoa normal! Eu queria viver em paz. Mas você quem começou. Espero que você esteja preparado diante das ameaças de sua nova vida, Gang Jinho pode se livrar de seus impulsos como o Mestre Demoníaco Vermelho e conseguir a 'vida normal' que ele tanto deseja? Essa é a adaptação da história de um lendário artista marcial no século XXI! <A Descendência do Mestre Demoníaco>

description.de: Mein letztes Leben war ein Alptraum: Zwischen einem Freund, der mich betrog, und einem Job, bei dem ich ständig nur angeschrien wurde, hatte ich selbst den letzten Funken an Hoffnung verloren. Und dann auch noch das: Nachdem ich bei einem Autounfall ums Leben komme, finde ich mich plötzlich im Körper von „Alexa der Killerbestie” wieder: Eine Prinzessin, die gleichzeitig eine sehr haarige aber auch sehr starke Bestie ist!
description.en:
*I've become a big, hairy beast!*

After getting into a car accident, Hanbyul wakes up in the body of a princess. But something's wrong; she's doubled in size, grown hair everywhere, and seems to terrify everyone who looks her way — she's become a beast! How will she live on as the cursed Princess Alexa?

----
"Am I really… a beast?"

Lee Hanbyul, a university student born with only a dirt spoon in her mouth, opens her eyes to a hardcore transmigration life!

After meeting her tragic end in a car accident, she possesses the body of "Alexa," the second princess of the kingdom of Felipe. However she wakes up not as a normal person, but as a furry beast…

Not only does she have to juggle getting rid of her beastly appearance with getting close to Verkyllon, the Grand Duke of the Veiled Kingdom, but she also has to keep the families and nobility that are after her for revenge in check.

This is a comical story about Alexa, second princess of the kingdom of Felipe's relentless pursuit of revenge.
description.es:
*¡Me convertí en una bestia grande y peluda!*

Luego de un accidente de tránsito, Hanbyul despierta en el cuerpo de una princesa. Pero algo raro está sucediendo: es el doble de grande, con pelos por doquier y todo aquel que la mira, termina asustado. ¡Se ha convertido en una bestia! ¿Cómo hará para vivir como la Princesa Alexa y con su maldición?
description.fr: Ma vie n’était franchement pas géniale. Entre un copain qui me trompait, et un taf où je me faisais crier dessus nonstop, j’avais vraiment perdu tout espoir. Ivre, je me suis lancée au milieu de la route avant de mourir dans un accident de voiture. Et quand j’ai rouvert les yeux, je me suis retrouvée dans le corps d’une... princesse toute poilue.
description.hu:
*"Én tényleg... egy szörny vagyok?"*

Hanbyul Lee, az egyetemista lány, egy autóbaleset után egy szőrrel borított bestia testében ébred. Főhősnőnk talpraesetten állja meg a helyét egy másik világ bonyolult nemesi közegében. Szórakoztató történet Alexáról, a Felipe királyság második hercegnőjéről és a bosszújáról, amiért rosszul bántak vele.
description.id: Terlempar ke isekai, tapi jadi monster buruk rupa?! Gadis ini menjadi Putri Alexa yang dikutuk, tapi ia bertekad memperbaiki nasib dengan cara mencukur bulu-bulu di tubuhnya dan merebut kembali posisinya sebagai anak sang raja. Alexa harus berhadapan dengan kakak perempuannya ya (sepertinya) berniat buruk, juga bertemu dengan Great Duke yang katanya juga terkutuk...
description.ja: 転生した身体はまさかの野獣！？王国で一番嫌われている王女による野性的なイケメン狩りがはじまる！
description.ko:
"나 설마… 야수야?" 
흙수저 대학생 이한별, 어느 날 눈을 뜨니 하드코어한 빙의 라이프가 기다리고 있다! 

교통사고 후 정신을 차리니 자신은 펠리페 왕국의 공주, '알렉사'로 빙의되어 있었다. 
하지만 알렉사의 정체는 평범한 사람이 아닌 털북숭이 야수였는데…. 

야수에서 벗어나고자 노력하고, 
베일에 싸인 왕국의 대공, 벨켈론과 가까워지고, 
자신을 견제하는 가족들과 귀족 무리에게 복수하기까지. 

새로 태어난 펠리페 왕국의 공주, 알렉사의 코믹한 복수 성장기!
description.ru:
Это комичная история об Алексе, второй принцессе королевства Фелипе, неустанно стремящейся к мести.

Главная героиня - Ли Ханбюль, студентка университета, родившаяся только с грязной ложкой во рту, открывает глаза на жесткую жизнь переселения душ!
Встретив свой трагический конец в автомобильной катастрофе, она овладевает телом "Алексы", второй принцессы королевства Фелипе. Однако просыпается она не как обычный человек, а как пушистый зверь…

Мало того, что она должна жонглировать избавлением от своей звериной внешности с приближением к Веркиллону, великому герцогу Королевства Вуали, но она также должна держать в узде семьи и дворянство, которые преследуют ее для мести.
description.th: ชีวิตของฉันมันบัดซบที่สุดเลย หลังจากที่จับได้ว่าแฟนแอบนอกใจคาหนังคาเขา วันๆ ก็ได้แต่รับมือกับพวกที่ชอบหาเรื่องในร้านเหล้าที่ทำงานพาร์ตไทม์อยู่ แล้วก็ดันวิ่งออกไปกลางถนนตอนเมาจนต้องมาตายด้วยอุบัติเหตุทางรถยนต์ พอลืมตาขึ้นมาอีกทีฉันก็กลายเป็น...คนขนปุกปุยไปซะแล้ว
description.zh: 某天睁开眼睛，我发现自己的生活有了天翻地覆的变化！我竟然附身到费利佩王国的公主阿莱莎身上。 但阿莱莎的身份却不是普通人，而且全身长毛的野兽……从此以后，我开始为了摆脱野兽身份而努力，向牵制自己的家人和贵族们报仇。 重获新生的的毛怪公主的搞笑复仇成长记！
description.pt-br:
*"Eu não acho que estou …"*

Lee Han-byul, uma estudante universitária com uma colher e pauzinhos, abriu os olhos um dia e uma vida dura espera por ela!

Quando recobrou o juízo após um acidente de trânsito, foi apelidada de "Alexa", a princesa do Reino de Philip.
Mas Alexa era uma fera peluda, não uma pessoa comum...

Tentando sair da forma besta, ela se aproxima de Belkelon, o Valeen Grão-duque do Reino.

A cômica vingança de Alexa, a recém-nascida princesa do Reino Philip!
description.zh-hk: 「我難道…是野獸？」 窮苦大學生李韓星，某天睜開眼後，發現充滿挑戰的穿越生活正等待著她！ ​ 交通事故後，李韓星醒來發現自己變成了費利佩王國的公主「亞莉莎」。 不過亞莉莎​的真實身份竟然不是普通人，而是毛茸茸的大野獸…？！ 又ㄎㄧㄤ又好笑的成長復仇記一起追下去！

In the real world, Taehyun Kim has a boring low-effort life, but as a virtual reality gamer, he lives for a harsh challenge. Why become the best player in the world’s hottest online game if you’re going to do it the easy way?

Warrior? Nope. Rogue? Nah. Taehyun wants to reach #1 as a blacksmith or, even better yet, unemployed. Unfortunately for him, his natural skills keep interfering, and this game likes him way too much! 

Seriously, how the hell did he end up as the god of luck?!

description.en: Fabre, a famous million-viewer streamer known for his daring encounters with venomous creatures, is bitten by a black mamba while filming in Africa and wakes up in the mystical world of Murim. To his surprise, the jungles of Murim offer him a peaceful farming life in which he enjoys cultivating various poisonous species. But his tranquility is short-lived when he crosses paths with members of the Tang Clan, the masters of poison and devious tactics. "I see potential in you. Become a part of our family.""
description.pt-br: Spicy Fabre, um streamer popular com mais de um milhão de inscritos e uma reputação como especialista em venenos e insetos venenosos, enfrentou uma inesperada reviravolta do destino. Durante uma gravação local na África, ele foi mordido por uma mamba negra e teve uma morte prematura – apenas para despertar no mundo das artes marciais. Agora, nas profundezas da selva, cultivando insetos venenosos, o streamer atraiu a atenção do Clã Tang de Sichuan, famoso por seu domínio nas artes do veneno, que o quer em suas fileiras. “Junte-se a nós e torne-se um membro de nosso clã.”

description.de: Jin Hyuk ist Streamer und der einzige, der das Ende des Virtual-Reality-Spiels „Turm der Prüfungen“ erlebt hat. Da das Spiel jedoch immer mehr an Beliebtheit verliert, wird auch seine Streamer-Karriere immer hoffnungsloser. Doch eines Tages wird „Turm der Prüfungen" plötzlich zur Realität und die Welt steht vor dem Abgrund. Jin Hyuk, der sich im Spiel besser auskennt als jeder andere, wird zwangsläufig zur letzten Hoffnung der Menschheit!
description.en:
Kang Jinhyeok, a gaming streamer and content creator, is the only person who has cleared the game, [Tower of Trials]. However, as the game’s popularity declines, it becomes increasingly difficult for him to continue making a living as a content creator. 

Jinhyeok prepares to end his 11-year-long relationship with the game and say goodbye to his humble group of subscribers. But on that very day, the Tower of Trials appears in reality with a message saying that humanity will perish unless all players clear each floor within 90 days.

Jinhyeok, who knows the game better than anyone, decides to use his knowledge to his advantage and dominate the tower.
description.fr: Le jeu de réalité virtuelle "La Tour de l'Épreuve" est officiellement démodé et le streamer Jinhyuk est le seul à être resté jusqu'au bout pour terminer le jeu. Quand un jour "La Tour de l'Épreuve" devient réalité, Jinhyuk qui connaît les éléments du jeu mieux que personne aura forcément un grand avantage sur les autres !
description.id: Jinhyuk, satu-satunya pemain game [MENARA UJIAN] yang menyelesaikan sampai akhir meski popularitas game telah menurun. Hingga suatu hari [MENARA UJIAN] menjadi kenyataan, Jinhyuk harus menyelesaikannya dengan segala elemen yang ia ketahui tentang game ini!
description.ja: ゲーム実況ストリーマーとして活動している主人公・鈴木裕人（すずきひろと）。彼は、万人があきらめたクソゲー『試練の塔』を挑戦しクリアした唯一のプレイヤーであった。念願のエンディングを見ることができたものの、もう誰も興味をもたないこのゲームはサービス終了が確実視されていた…。11年もかけクソゲーをクリアした裕人はこれを機に現実と向き合い、ゲーム実況者としての生活を終わらせることを決心した—。が次の日、現実世界に異変が起きる。街中に突如現れた不吉な塔、そして人類に課される生死をかけた試練。それはまさに裕人が11年の月日を費やしクリアした『試練の塔』そのものであった。塔の攻略法を把握している裕人はその経験を活かし、誰よりも強い最強のビギナーとしてあらたな試練に挑む！
description.ko:
게임 너튜버로 활동 중인 주인공 진혁은 유일하게
[시련의 탑]의 엔딩을 봤지만, 게임의 인기가 하락하며
더 이상 게임 너튜버로서의 삶도 유지하기 힘들어진다.

엔딩을 보았기에 이대로 게임을 마무리하려는 진혁.
바로 그날, [시련의 탑]은 현실이 되었다.
게임의 모든 요소를 다 알고 있는 진혁은
누구보다 빠르게 모든 것을 차지한다!

"진짜 고인물이 뭔지 보여주지."
description.ru:
Главный герой Джин Хек – игрок и стример, единственный, кто прошёл до конца «Башню испытаний».
Когда он увидел концовку игры, захотел бросить её. Но в тот же день «Башня испытания» стала реальностью. И главному герою не осталось ничего, кроме как показать, на что способен тот, кто знает все нюансы игры.

«Я покажу вам, что такое настоящий задрот!»
description.th: "จินฮยอก" สตรีมเมอร์หนุ่ม ผู้หลงใหลในการเล่นเกม ใช้เวลากว่า 11 ปี ในการบรรลุชั้นบนสุดของ '[หอคอยแห่งความทรหด] เกมแฟนตาซีเสมือนจริง' พอบรรลุเป้าหมายแล้ว จึงเกิดความคิดที่อยากจะล้มเลิกการเล่นเกม และการทำสตรีมมิ่ง แต่จู่ๆ วันหนึ่งเขาก็ตื่นมาพบว่า [หอคอยแห่งความทรหด] โผล่ขึ้นมาในชีวิตจริงซะอย่างนั้น!?
description.zh:
当游戏变为现实！
无名主播竟是唯一通关者！
男主镇赫是一名游戏主播，也是唯一一位“试炼之塔”游戏的通关玩家。随着“试炼之塔”这款游戏的热度下降，游戏主播的工作渐渐无法维持镇赫的生活。通关后的镇赫本想就此退游，然而游戏竟成为了现实。如果失败世界就会灭亡！对游戏了如指掌的镇赫还能在现实世界中通关吗？
description.pt-br: Jinhyuk, um viciado completo, foi o único a ter visto o final da [Torre dos Testes], mas à medida que a popularidade do jogo diminui, fica difícil manter a vida com o jogo. Jinhyuk quer terminar o jogo assim porque ele viu o final. Naquele mesmo dia, a [Torre dos Testes] se tornou uma realidade. Jinhyuk, que conhece todos os elementos do jogo, controla tudo mais rápido do que qualquer um! “Vou te mostrar o que é um profissional de verdade.”
description.zh-hk: 活躍於遊戲NewTube頻道的主角——振赫，他是唯一看過[試煉之塔]的結局，因為該款遊戲的人氣大跌，要經營NewTube頻道再也難以維持生計。 看完遊戲的結局後，原本振赫預計要結束不再玩遊戲。但就在當天，[試煉之塔]竟成為了現實。了解遊戲所有關卡的振赫，比誰都還要快占據所有物品。 「讓你見識什麼是真正的開掛高手。」

altTitles.es: Lamia Orphe está muerta

altTitles.ja: ラミア・オルフェが死んだ

description.en:
Lamia Orphe is to become the future successor of the Orphe dukedom but at 22 years of age, she suddenly decides to give up her own title. On the other hand, the 2nd Prince, Aquila Theodore Benzer, has powers that transcend beyond that of a normal human. Notorious for being cruel and merciless as the son of the "desert witch," he competes against his brother, the 1st Prince Ethan Tayler Benzer, to succeed the throne. What lies in store for Aquila and Lamia? How are their fates intertwined with the legendary dragon?  


---
description.es:
Lamia Orphe se convertirá en la futura sucesora del ducado de Orphe, pero a los 22 años, de repente, decide renunciar a su propio título. Por otro lado, el segundo príncipe, Aquila Theodore Benzer, tiene poderes que trascienden más allá de los de un humano normal. Conocido por ser cruel y despiadado como el hijo de la "bruja del desierto", compite contra su hermano, el primer príncipe Ethan Tayler Benzer, para suceder al trono. ¿Qué le espera a Aquila y Lamia? ¿Cómo se entrelazan sus destinos con el legendario dragón?  


---
description.ru:
Рамия Орфе должна стать будущей наследницей герцогства Орфе, но в 22 года она внезапно решает отказаться от своего собственного титула. С другой стороны, 2-й принц, Аквила Теодор Бензер, обладает силами, превосходящими возможности обычного человека. Печально известный своей жестокостью и беспощадностью как сын "ведьмы пустыни", он соперничает со своим братом, 1-м принцем Итаном Тайлером Бензером, чтобы унаследовать трон. Что ждет Аквилу и Рамию? Как их судьбы переплетутся с легендарным драконом?  


---

description.en:
Jang Suchan is an extraordinary college student at the top of the social food chain. But underneath the perfect façade, he hides a pair of insect wings that suddenly grew when he used a mysterious bug spray called "Jungle Juice.” Suchan's life crumbles when he bares his wings to the world to save someone's life. When all hope seems lost, Suchan stumbles upon a hidden world of insect humans where everyone is accepted for what they are.

But the law of the jungle governs this secret society and all must fend for themselves in order to survive.
description.fr:
Le mystérieux insecticide "Jungle Juice" a fait de lui un humain insecte.  
Jang Su-chan, un étudiant qui cachait ses dents, a un jour ressemblé à cela.  
Vous serez vu par tout le monde, et vous serez dans le monde des insectes.  
Vous vous battrez contre la logique du faible…  
  
Action/ Fantaisie de divers pouvoirs d'insectes  
Le nouveau héros de Super String Universe fait son apparition !
description.pt-br: Jang Suchan é um aluno universitário no topo de sua cadeia social. Mas, debaixo da faixada perfeita, ele esconde um par de asas de inseto que cresceram de repente após usar um inseticida misterioso chamado “Jungle Juice”. A vida de Suchan desmorona quando ele exibe suas asas ao mundo afim salvar a vida de outra pessoa. Quando toda a esperança parece perdida, Suchan se depara com um mundo escondido de insetos humanos onde todos são aceitos por quem são. Mas a lei da selva governa essa sociedade secreta e todos devem lutar para sobreviverem.

description.ko:
이계의 신, 아우터 갓(Outer God).

하늘을 닫는 절망과 늪에 빠진 좌절, 탄생하지 못한 자, 어리석은 혼돈.
평범한 사람들은 그저 바라보는 것만으로 목숨을 잃어 버릴 그 존재들이 세상을 휘젓는 지금…
수 년간의 싸움 끝에, 최후의 생존자들이 낸 결론.

"이너(Inner)는 아우터(Outer)를 이길 수 없다."

그 순간, 시간을 다루는 신격을 지닌 존재 크로노스는 자신을 희생시켜 시계태엽을 되돌린다.

"이길 수 없겠지. 지금은 말이야."

"옛 세계선으로 돌아가라. 그리고 다시 시작해."

모든 신들에게 지목을 받아 과거로 돌아간 최후의 1인.
가장 뒤늦게 탑을 올라, 가장 마지막까지 신들과 함께 싸운 인간, 김유원.

"이너(Inner)는 아우터(Outer)를 이길 수 없다. 그렇다면…"

"이기는 건 나야."

그는 마지막 순간을 함께하던 동료들을 다시 모아,
아우터와의 싸움을 승리로 끝낼 수 있을까?

Mas Yuwon é tenaz demais para desistir. Sua perda se torna o início de uma nova jornada como repatriado. Com determinação renovada, Yuwon recomeça de onde começou, destruindo monstro após monstro e reaprendendo suas habilidades antes de enfrentar a Torre mais uma vez.

Mas ele conseguirá abrir caminho através dos tutoriais e subir de nível mais uma vez, ou sua conquista desmoronará diante dele?

description.en:
I was falsely accused of attempting to kill my younger sister, who was worshipped as a holy maiden. There was not a single person who believed in me, nor was there a person who stood up for me. Not even my blood-related family. I was fourteen years old, and it was winter. I, who was Edenbell's Fourth Princess, was miserably beheaded in front of the masses. After the end of my death, I awoke and what came was...

"My baby, my precious younger sister."

With a delightful smile, he held my small fingers. That warm gesture, warmth, and touch. He sang me a lullaby as he held me gently and swayed.

---
When Princess Alisa is framed for a terrible crime, she is shocked to learn that her own family wants her executed. After losing her will to live, she finds herself reborn as the princess of a rival empire. And though her new family acts sweet and kind on the surface, she's not sure they can be truly trusted. Luckily, with this new life comes new power. But what exactly is this mysterious magic that awakens in her? And more importantly, can she use it to get vengeance against those who once betrayed her?

description.fr:
Alyssa, la quatrième princesse d’Edenbell, est accusée à tort d’avoir tenté de tuer sa petite sœur. Condamnée froidement à mort par sa famille, elle se réincarne comme princesse de l’empire rival, Elmir. Dégoutée par la trahison de ses proches, elle jure de ne plus jamais aimer qui que ce soit. Mais l’empire d’Elmir est bien différent de celui d’Edenbell… Dans ce nouvel environnement, parviendra-t-elle à retrouver foi en l'humanité et à découvrir les terribles secrets qui entourent son exécution?

---
Personne n’a cru en moi, personne n’était là pour me soutenir, même ma propre famille. A ce moment-là, j’étais Alyssa, 4e princesse d’Edenbell. J’étais dans un état épouvantable et j’avais la gorge asséchée par la soif. J’ai regardé ma sœur cadette, espérant qu’elle les empêcherait de me tuer. Mais ce que j’ai vu sur son visage, c’était une expression d’extase, elle était heureuse d’assister à ma mort. Après avoir été exécutée, j’ai ouvert de nouveau mes yeux. J’étais dans le ventre de quelqu’un et je pouvais entendre des voix. Avant de retomber dans l’inconscience, j’ai entendues les paroles d’un petit garçon:

«Bienvenue, ma précieuse petite sœur,» il a ri chaleureusement, «Le monde entier t’aime.»

Je me suis réincarnée en tant que première princesse de l’empire Elmir, le rival de l’empire Edenbell!

description.it:
Quando la principessa Alicia viene incastrata per un terribile crimine, rimane scioccata nell'apprendere che la sua stessa famiglia vuole che sia giustiziata. Dopo aver perso la voglia di vivere, si ritrova a rinascere come la principessa di un impero rivale. E sebbene la sua nuova famiglia si comporti in modo dolce e gentile in superficie, non è sicura che ci si possa veramente fidare di loro. Fortunatamente, con questa nuova vita arriva un nuovo potere. Ma cos'è esattamente questa misteriosa magia che si risveglia in lei? E, cosa più importante, può usarla per vendicarsi di coloro che una volta l'hanno tradita?

description.ja:
イデンベル帝国の皇女アリサには腹違いの妹マリアンヌがいた。 金色の瞳を持ち誰からも愛される華やかな妹に対し、アリサは使用人にも冷遇を受けていた。 アリサがマリアンヌをお茶に招待した日、突然マリアンヌが血を吐き倒れる。 家族からも嫉妬したアリサが毒を入れたと決めつけられ、アリサは死刑になる。この濡れ衣はマリアンヌの陰謀だった。 もう人間には生まれ変わりたくないと神に願ったが、アリサはライバル国・エルミール帝国の皇女アイシャとして転生してしまう。 前世と正反対の愛情深い家族。特に腹違いの兄・イシスにやすらぎを感じ次第に心を開いて行く。 精霊使いの能力を持ち、賢く優しい少女へと成長するアイシャは、前世の残酷な記憶を乗り越え再び光の中で輝けるのか!?

description.en: Top Korean hunter Siu 'The Rabid Hound' Min defeated the Demon Lord with his disciples, only to be trapped in a monster-filled otherworld for 100 years. However, a century of struggles did not break Siu—it drove him to break his limits instead. Now, he returns to Earth with Pred, his mysterious partner, only to learn that his name and legacy have been erased, along with his disciples’... and that only 10 years have passed on Earth. As new conflicts arise, will Siu and Pred prevail and uncover the truth?
description.ko:
대한민국 최상위 헌터, '광견' 민시우.

제자들과 마왕을 처치한 순간! 이계로 보내지고, 마물이 가득한 이계에서 100년 동안의 싸움 끝에 드디어 지구로 돌아왔다!

'그런데, 왜 내 존재가 사람들에게 잊힌 거지?'

이계에서의 100년은 지구에서의 10년이었고, 100년의 혈투로 '고인물'이 되어 돌아온 민시우는흩어진 제자들과 본인의 존재가 잊힌 이유를 찾아 나선다!

description.en:
At age 13, the genius wizard Rin embarked on a journey with Lista and the hero party to defeat the great evil known as “the Abyss,” which sought to plunge the world into chaos. But as the battle grew more intense, Rin’s body succumbed to the dark poison of the Abyss, putting his life in grave danger.

With the words “I’ll come back,” Rin’s soul entered a forced dormancy, only to reawaken 300 years later as a noble boy. Starting his second life in a peaceful world, Rin discovers that on one side of the world, the destined forces of darkness are beginning to stir once more.

---
The battle with the arch-nemesis resumes after 300 years. The genius wizard, Lynn, embarks on a grand journey, at the age of 13. Together with the party of heroes, led by Esther, they aim to defeat the great evil “Abyss” that intends to throw the world into chaos. However, the battles becomes increasingly fierce and at the final moment, Lynn succumbs to the dark poison of the “Abyss”. Leaving behind the words “I’ll be back”, Lynn’s soul falls dormant for 300 years, before being resurrected into the body of a boy of noble birth. Thus begins his second life in a peaceful world. But in the meantime, a dark force is brooding once again, threatening to plunge the world into turmoil once again.

---
The warrior Lista heard the rumors about the great magician Rin, hailed as a genius for becoming the youngest 4-star mage. Lista recruited him to join her party to fight the forces of the void but, right before the final battle, Rin’s body succumbed to the void’s dark poison. As he drew his last breath, Rin cast an immortality spell, encasing his body in ice and promising Lista that he would return. Rin kept his promise and returned after 300 years--but reborn in the body of a noble boy.
description.es-la: El genio mago Lynn se embarca en un gran viaje a la edad de 13 años. Junto con el grupo de héroes, liderado por Esther, su objetivo es derrotar al gran malvado "Abismo" que pretende llevar al mundo al caos. Sin embargo, las batallas se vuelven cada vez más feroces y en el momento final, Lynn sucumbe al oscuro veneno del "Abismo". Dejando atrás las palabras "Volveré", el alma de Lynn permanece dormida durante 300 años, antes de resucitar en el cuerpo de un niño de noble cuna. Así comienza su segunda vida en un mundo pacífico. Pero mientras tanto, una fuerza oscura está acechando una vez más, amenazando con hundir al mundo en la confusión una vez más.

altTitles.es-la: Probablemente... invencible?

description.en: Hyeol Yu is a third-rate warrior feared more for his menacing appearance than his actual skills. Branded by false rumors and endless misunderstandings, he has long been an outcast in the world of martial arts. But everything changes when Seolhwa, the woman he once vowed his life to, reappears before him as a true martial arts master. From that moment on, Hyeol is thrust into chaos, his name weaving its way through the ranks of warriors, sects, and factions. As his unwanted reputation spirals out of control, he is pulled into a conflict far greater than he ever imagined.
description.ko:
험악한 겉모습 때문에 '사파의 별'이라 불리던 삼류 무사 유혈.
헛소문 때문에 억울한 나날을 보내던 중 과거, 미래를 약속했던 여인 설화가 진짜배기 고수가 되어 그의 앞에 나타난다.

설화를 시작으로 수많은 무림인들과 엮이며 악명은 점점 커져만 가고 이윽고 무림맹과 마교, 심지어는 황실까지 그의 이름이 들어가게 되는데...

"아니... 다 오해라니까요?"
description.es-la: Yoo Hyeol, un guerrero de tercera categoría apodado infamemente “La Estrella de las Artes Oscuras” debido a su apariencia amenazante, vivió una vida plagada de falsos rumores y malentendidos sin fin. Un día, Seolhwa, la mujer a la que una vez le prometió su futuro, reaparece ante él, ya no es la figura gentil que recordaba, sino una formidable maestra de las artes marciales. A partir de ese momento, su nombre se enreda con las vidas de innumerables guerreros, lo que hace que su ya infame reputación se vuelva cada vez más complicada. A medida que su supuesta “notoriedad” se extiende, la Alianza Murim, el Culto del Demonio e incluso la corte real se fijan en él. "No, en serio... ¡todo es solo un gran malentendido!" Pero, ¿podrá convencer al mundo de lo contrario? ¿O se convertirá involuntariamente en la leyenda que nunca quiso ser?
description.pt-br:
Yoo Hyeol, um guerreiro de terceira categoria infamemente apelidado de “A Estrela das Artes Sombrias” devido à sua aparência intimidadora, viveu uma vida atormentada por falsos rumores e constantes mal-entendidos. Um dia, Seolhwa — a mulher a quem ele uma vez prometeu seu futuro — reaparece diante dele, já não sendo a figura gentil que ele lembrava, mas uma formidável mestre em artes marciais.

A partir desse momento, o nome de Yoo Hyeol se entrelaça com as vidas de incontáveis guerreiros, ampliando ainda mais sua já notória reputação. À medida que sua “fama” se espalha, até mesmo a Aliança Murim, o Culto Demoníaco e a corte real começam a prestar atenção nele.

“Não, sério… tudo isso é só um grande mal-entendido!”

Mas será que ele conseguirá convencer o mundo do contrário? Ou acabará se tornando, sem querer, a lenda que nunca almejou ser?

description.en:
Faced with imminent defeat and certain death, would you choose to run – or continue to fight for a doomed world?

When mysterious towers appear across the world, summoning monsters that prey on mankind, this is the choice presented to the Tower Walkers – adventurers with special powers to fight the monsters.

On the brink of death, they can choose to use a “regression stone” to return to the past for a second chance, though this decision places them in a separate timeline forever.

Stubborn Tower Walker Jaehwan rejects this choice, choosing to fight for the original timeline, and learning shocking secrets about the Tower along the way.
description.ko:
<전지적 독자 시점> 싱숑 작가 원작.

이것은 모두가 과거로 돌아갈 때 마지막까지 회귀하지 않았던 한 사나이의 이야기다.
description.pt-br: Esta é a história de um homem que não voltou quando todos retornaram ao passado. Os humanos foram convocados de repente para se tornarem “Andarilhos” e precisavam limpar a torre para salvar o mundo… 77º Andar: A Pedra do Retorno foi descoberta. Andarilhos podiam agora retornar ao passado. Lentamente, todos foram embora… A última esperança da humanidade, “Carpe Diem”, foi formada com as pessoas que se recusaram a abandonar o mundo… O último Andarilho chegou ao 100º andar. Ele não sabia mais no que crer. Obs.: Essa é a adaptação da novel que existe dentro da novel/manhwa Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint e que o protagonista lê em sua juventude.

description.en:
Henry Morris was an 8-circled wizard who was a legend- one of the founding fathers who helped his friend become the king of a unified empire. After the son took over the throne, Henry was executed with the false accusation of leading a rebellion against the empire. 

He then wakes up in the body of young Henry Morris, the eldest of a baron family, who also happened to have the same name. 

Henry turns his life around by again relearning magic and also swordsmanship in order to become the first magic swordsman, all for the sake of revenge.
description.ja: 人類最初の８サークル魔術師の主人公は反逆罪で殺されるが、黒魔術を行なったヘンリー・モーリスの体に転生する。 死ぬ直前に騎士のような強い肉体の大切さを痛感したため、今世では剣術を磨くことを決意する。 帝国の剣術を身につけ、死んだ剣王まで黒魔術で呼び出し、転生した魔剣師による復讐劇がいま始まる…！
description.ko:
대륙을 통일한 구국의 영웅이자 
8서클의 대마법사 헨리 모리스! 

친우였던 선대 황제가 죽은 뒤 
아들인 현 황제가 귀족의 꼭두각시가 되면서 
반역죄로 몰려 어이없이 처형을 당하게 된다. 

그리고 모든 것의 끝이라는 죽음을 맞이한 그 순간! 
'헨리'라는 같은 이름을 가진 약해 빠진  
어느 검사의 몸으로 되살아난다. 

"이번 생에 내가 할일은 정해진 것 같군. 
8서클 대마법사이자 소드마스터가 되는 거야!" 

지옥에서 돌아온 헨리의 화려하고 잔혹한 복수극이 지금 시작된다!!!
description.ru: Герой, спасший целый континент Верховный архимаг восьми кругов Генри Морис. После смерти императора Сондэ, с которым он был близок, аристократы превратили сына императора в марионетку, а он был казнён за измену. Уже умирая, в момент, когда все должно было закончиться, он перемещается в тело слабого и, по всей видимости, ленивого сына барона по имени "Генри". Теперь великий маг восьми кругов станет мастером меча! Роскошная и жестокая месть Генри начинается сейчас!

description.en:
Ji-Woo Lee, an author gets reincarnated into her novel as Tara Elias, the 5th daughter of the Elias family. However, the family is supposed to fall soon, and everyone in it will be executed. Ji-Woo insists that she will escape her fate.  
  
"I thought everything was going smoothly."  
  
That is, until she meets the second prince. Prince Kyle Amur.

---
*They walked over me. Now I rule over them.*

After being murdered, Yeonwoo is reincarnated as Tara Elias, the unremarkable and incompetent 5th daughter of the Elias family. How will Tara Elias, the nobody of the family, save the entire household from its grisly ending and become the ruler of the kingdom?

Malheureusement, on est loin de la vie de rêve: Tæra a beau être de la noblesse, tout le monde la méprise! Et pire que tout: dans l’œuvre originale, sa famille va être exécutée. Чжи-Ву Ли, писательница, перевоплощается в своем же романе в Тару Эллиос, пятую дочь семьи Эллиосов, которая страдает лишним весом. title.en: The Secret of the Partner Next to You

altTitles.es-la: El secreto de Jae-Kyung

description.en: Yang Kiryong is an ordinary high school boy who has a classmate named Yoo Jae-Kyung, who is somewhat clumsy and clueless. Both have a very good friendship, but without any kind of love attraction. Until one day, by chance, Kiryong discovered the deepest secret of his friend and because of this his heart began to beat, will it be beats of fear or love?
description.ko:
평범한 남자 고등학생 양기룡.
그리고 언제나 헤실헤실하고 가끔 나사빠진 행동을 하는
그의 짝꿍 유재경.
그럭저럭 귀엽다고 생각되는 반 친구였을 뿐인데..
어느 날 우연히 그녀의 위험한 비밀을 알게 된다.
이 심장의 두근거림은 두려움인지, 설렘인지..?
description.es-la: Yang Kiryong es un chico de preparatoria común y corriente, que tiene una compañera de clase llamada Yoo Jae-Kyung, la cual es algo torpe y despistada. Ambos tienen una muy buena amistad, pero sin ningún tipo de atracción amorosa. Hasta que un día, por casualidad, Kiryong descubrió el secreto más profundo de su amiga y debido a esto su corazón empezó a latir, ¿serán latidos de miedo o amor?
description.pt-br: Yang Kiryong é um garoto comum do ensino médio que tem uma colega de classe chamada Yoo Jae-Kyung, que é um pouco desajeitada e sem noção. Ambos têm uma amizade muito boa, mas sem nenhum tipo de atração amorosa. Até que um dia, por acaso, Kiryong descobriu o segredo mais profundo de sua amiga. Por causa disso seu coração começou a bater, será de medo ou de amor?

description.en:
Grand Duke Hadelrune de Strelitz is the hero of the empire and Lady Zernoa de Rhanterra is the “golden flower” of high society. What commonalities could they share besides their glowing reputations? Apparently, secrets. One day, Zernoa comes across an unassuming pile of clothes under which she is startled to find an adorable rabbit who also happens to be… Grand Duke Hadelrune. An ancient family curse and a fictitious upbringing… What else could these two be hiding?!

---

**Links:**
- [Official Chinese Translation](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/9825/)
description.pt:
“A Duquesa de Gernoa de Lantera”, atrai a atenção da alta sociedade. Mas ela é uma farsa! Seu nome verdadeiro é Larissa. Uma menina que dirigia vendedores ambulantes no mercado para famílias pobres. Ela foi vendida a um duque por sua família, para fazer o papel de sua filha morta, e está vivendo em perigo.  
  
Um coelho de pelo preto nos braços de uma falsa duquesa. Esse coelho também é falso! O coelho é o grão-duque Hadelund Strelitz, admirado por todos no continente. Ele é o mestre e herói do Grão-Ducado, onde residem as feras do Inferno, mas agora é um coelho fofo por causa de um feitiço.  
  
O grão-duque, que por acaso foi salvo por Larissa e recebeu seus cuidados, naturalmente aprende sobre a situação de Larissa e secretamente a ajuda. Larissa, que está sendo forçada pelo duque a seduzir o príncipe e se casar com ele para se tornar a futura rainha do país, e Hadelund, que passa a conhecer cada vez mais o valor dela, se interessa por ela. O encontro se torna destino e a vida de Larissa começa a mudar mais uma vez.

description.en:
Living in a world infested with monsters is hard enough, but doing it without powers? That’s Hanyeol’s life in a nutshell.

Fearsome beasts roam the earth and kill everyone in their path. Elite members of society called the Awakened mobilize to protect humanity with their supernatural abilities. Amidst it all, Hanyeol is just a poor porter, tasked as sideline support.

But when a benevolent being gifts him with special abilities, he’s ready to harvest all the loot and take it to the next level!

description.en: With a broken heart, Hwayoung falls headfirst into the river by accident but wakes up as infamous villainess Satiana Altisee Kaylon. Coming to terms with her new life as sole daughter of House Kaylon, Satiana is soon chosen as a candidate for the next empress! In the palace full of schemers and liars, she must become a cold-blooded villainess to win her royal seat by the crown prince - or her new family will face grave danger!  Will being perfectly evil really be enough? ‘Cause even villains need love!
description.fr: A quoi bon être gentille et juste toute sa vie si c’est pour se faire larguer et être moquée de tous? Réincarnée dans un monde remplis de nobles et de princes, elle doit adopter la personnalité de l’ancienne propriétaire de son corps, une tyran insupportable, afin de protéger sa famille et déjouer les plans que lui réserve le prince… Parfois, cela fait un bien fou d’être méchante!
description.id: Dengan patah hati, Hwayoung jatuh lebih dulu ke sungai secara tidak sengaja tetapi bangun sebagai penjahat terkenal Satiana Altisee Kaylon. Setelah menerima kehidupan barunya sebagai putri tunggal Keluarga Kaylon, Satiana segera terpilih sebagai calon permaisuri berikutnya! Di istana yang penuh dengan perencana dan pembohong, dia harus menjadi penjahat berdarah dingin untuk memenangkan kursi kerajaannya oleh putra mahkota - atau keluarga barunya akan menghadapi bahaya besar! Apakah kejahatan yang sempurna sudah cukup? Karena penjahat pun butuh cinta!
description.ko:
“난 이미 내 황후를 정했고, 넌 구색 맞추기일 뿐이야.”
“바로 내가 제국의 황후가 될 거예요.”

가장 친한 친구에게 남자친구를 뺏긴 날,
나는 실수로 한강에 빠지고 말았다.
그리고 눈떠 보니 악녀로 이름난 공작영애
샤르티아나 알티제 카일론이 되어 있었다!

알고 보니 이 샤르티아나 영애,
황태자를 그 연인에게서 가로채려 했다고 한다.
그런 악녀 따위는 절대로 되지 않을 거라고 다짐하고 싶지만……
차기 황후 후보, ‘레지나’로 간택되는 순간 내 운명도 결정되었다.

레지나 후보는 둘, 나 샤르티아나와 황태자의 연인 아이린.
모략이 휘몰아치는 궁정에서 사랑하는 가족을 지키기 위해
철저한 악녀가 되어 황후의 자리를 쟁취할 수밖에 없다.
그런데 현실을 받아들이기로 결심한 순간,
차갑기만 했던 황태자 레오프리드가 다른 얼굴을 보이기 시작한다.
그리고 아이린과의 관계에도 무언가 비밀이……?

사랑하는 사람들과 행복해지기 위해, 나는 희대의 악녀가 된다.

달콤살벌한 궁중 로맨스의 새로운 정의!

—

소설에서 풀지 못했던 못 다한 이야기가
지금 여기에서 펼쳐집니다!

description.ru:
В тот день, когда парень и лучшая подруга предали меня, я по ошибке упала в реку Хан.
Но очнувшись, я оказалась в теле Чартианы Альтицер Кейлон, дочери герцога.

Моя судьба была определена в тот момент, когда меня выбрали кандидаткой в императрицы.

Чтобы защитить мою новую семью от последствий коварных замыслов двора, мне придётся стать хладнокровной злодейкой и выиграть в битве за престол.

Будет ли этого достаточно? Ведь даже злодейки нуждаются в любви!
description.th: ‘ยูฮวายอง’ หญิงสาวผู้ชอกช้ำใจในความรักที่หนีไปดื่มเหล้าจนเมามาย แต่ดันเกิดเคราะห์ซ้ำกรรมซ้อนทำให้เธอตกน้ำจนถึงแก่ชีวิต แต่ทว่าโลกหลังความตายของเธอกลับไม่ได้เป็นอย่างที่คิด เพราะเธอดันมาอยู่ในร่างของ ‘ชาร์เทียน่า อัลทิเซอร์ ไคล์โลน’ บุตรสาวคนเดียวของท่านดยุคที่ขึ้นชื่อเรื่องความร้ายกาจประดุจนางร้ายในละคร ให้ตายสิ...นี่มันเรื่องบ้าอะไรเนี่ยยยยยย!! #การ์ตูนเจ้าหญิง #การ์ตูนโรแมนติก
description.tr: Erkek arkadaşımın beni en iyi arkadaşımla aldattığı gün, kazara Han Nehrine düştüm. Gözlerimi açtığımda kötü karakter olan Satiana Altizer Kaylon adında ünlü bir dükün kızı mı oldum!? “İmparatoriçemi çoktan seçtim ve sen sadece bir piyonsun.” "İmparatorluğun imparatoriçesi ben olacağım." Kaderim, bir sonraki imparatoriçe adayı olarak seçilmemden sonra çizildi. İki Regina adayı, Veliaht Prensin sevgilisi İrene ve ben Satiana. Sevgili ailemi mahkemenin kötü oyunlarına karşı korumak için kötü karakter ve imparatoriçe olmaktan başka çarem yok. Sevdiğim insanlarla mutlu olmak için kötü karakter oldum.
description.vi: Sau khi bị bạn thân và người yêu phản bội, Hwa Yeong uống say và trượt chân rơi xuống sông Hàn. Rồi tái sinh thành Chartiana Altise Kylone, con gái của công tước Kylone. Charti vốn là một ác nữ có tiếng. Phải làm sao để có thể giúp Charti gỡ bỏ danh ác nữ đây?
description.zh: 穿越成恶女与高冷皇太子恋爱？ 柳花迎惨遭闺蜜插足，伤心欲绝时掉进江水，醒来后却发现自己穿越到了名叫莎缇娜的贵族小姐身上。虽然保住了小命...但听说这身体的主人不仅刁蛮无礼，还贪恋别人的爱人? 等一下,我是清白的！

description.ar: أصبحت امرأة شريرة ماتت على يد زوجها في الرواية ، على وجه التحديد كشخصية داعمة تموت أثناء استخدامها كأداة للزواج السياسي من قبل والدها وشقيقها . وفي يوم من الأيام ، أحضر الأب أخيزا عريسها ... المشكلة أن الشخص الآخر هو الزوج الذي سيقتلني وأفضل فارس مقدس في الشمال الذي سيدمر الأسرة في المستقبل . أولا وقبل كل شيء ، يجب أن أجد طريقة للعيش . هناك العديد من الصعوبات مثل برودة الزوج ، وازدراء الدوق ، لكن يبدو أنه غير مؤذ للناس هنا . " لقد وقعت في حبك ! " لذا أرجوك أنقذني !
description.de: Gelandet in einem Roman als böse Figur, die von ihrem Vater und ihrem Bruder als Werkzeug für politische Heiratsallianzen ausgenutzt wird, stellt ihr Vater Rudbeckia eines Tages ihren fünften Verlobten vor, den sie schliesslich heiratet. Es stellt sich heraus, dass dieser nicht nur ihr zukünftiger Mörder, sondern auch der mächtigste Paladin des Nordens ist, der irgendwann ihre Familie ins Verderben stürzen wird. Im ursprünglichen Roman würde Rudbeckia ein tragisches Ende als gefallene Nebenfigur erleiden, aber dieses Mal muss sie einen Weg finden, um zu überleben.
description.en:
In the original lines of the novel, I was a villainess—used as a political tool by my father and older brother—who ended up dying at the hands of my future husband.

To save his kingdom, my father desperately begged my fifth groom to take my hand in marriage. The problem is that the man I’m supposed to marry, the legendary knight of the North, is the same man who will end up murdering me and my entire family.

I have to find a way to survive.

Within the novel itself, there are many daunting challenges ahead of me: I have to find a way to save my husband’s little sister, win over my cold-hearted husband, and gain the support of the people of the North, all of whom currently despise me.

“I’m in love with you!”

So please, don’t kill me!

---
I thought I'd finally escaped my hellish life when I died in an airplane crash, but I fell into another nightmare when I awoke as Rudbeckia de Borgia, a minor villain from a historical novel destined to die at the hands of her husband, Iske van Omerta. Surviving with the dysfunctional Borgia family is hard enough, but now I have to marry the man who will kill me! Still, it’s okay, I just have to convince Iske, his family, and all his countrymen that I’m completely harmless! How hard can that be?
description.es: Me convertí en Rudbekia, la villana dentro de una novela de fantasía que sería asesinada a manos de su marido. El maldito de mi padre, ya ha decidido con quien me volveré a casar a través de un matrimonio político. El principal problema, es que mi futuro esposo es quien me matara. Necesito encontrar una forma de sobrevivir. Si actuó inofensivamente ante la gente del Norte, si protejo a la hermana de mi marido, a quien maté en la historia original, y si finjo estar completamente enamorada de él, ¿tal vez me perdone la vida? —¡Me he enamorado de tí! ¡Así que por favor sálvame!
description.fa: در قسمت های اصلی رمان، من یه فرد شرور بودم که توسط پدر و برادر بزرگترم به عنوان یه ابزار سیاسی استفاده میشدم و در نهایت به دست شوهر آیندم کشته شدم. پدرم برای نجات پادشاهی خودش به شدت به داماد پنجم التماس میکرد که با من ازدواج کنه. مشکل اینه که مردی که قراره باهاش ازدواج کنم، شوالیه افسانه ای شمال، همون مردیه که در نهایت من و تمام خانوادم رو میکشه. "باید راهی برای زنده موندن پیدا کنم." داخل خود رمان چالش های دلهره آور زیادی پیشه رو هس. من باید راهی برای نجات خواهر کوچک شوهرم پیدا کنم، بر ظاهر سرد شوهرم پیروز شم، حمایت مردم شمال رو به دست بیارم و دربرابر اتفاقات عجیب با موجودات عجیبی دووم بیارم که در حال حاضر همه اینا منو به یه فرد انتقام جو تبدیل میکنن. "عاشق توعم!" "پس لطفاً منو نکش!"
description.fr:
Dans le roman, elle est devenue une méchante qui est morte des mains de son mari. Pour être plus précis, elle est devenue un personnage secondaire qui est morte en étant utilisée comme un outil pour un mariage politique par son père et son frère. Un jour, mon satané père est sorti en rampant et a choisi mon cinquième marié. Le problème est que la personne choisie était le meilleur paladin du Nord et la personne même qui me tuera moi et ma famille dans le futur. D’abord, je dois trouver un moyen de vivre. Dans le roman, avant de trouver un moyen de sauver ma belle-sœur qui allait mourir de mes mains, il y a de nombreux défis que je dois surmonter. Par exemple, faire fondre l’extérieur froid de mon mari, gagner les faveurs des gens du Nord et surmonter le mépris du duc. Si je peux surmonter ces défis, ma vie ne sera-t-elle pas sauvée plus tard? «Je suis tombé amoureux de toi !» Alors s’il te plaît, épargne-moi!

---
Une jeune coréenne est réincarnée dans le corps de Rudbeckia de Borgia, la seule fille du pape. Cependant, Rudbeckia est destinée à mourir des mains de son époux après avoir été utilisée comme outil dans un mariage politique. Prenant les devants pour changer son destin, elle décide de gagner l'affection de Izek van Omerta du royaume de Britannia, paladin, neveu du roi et héritier du duché d'Omerta. Rudbeckia pourra-t-elle empêcher le meurtre de sa belle-sœur, assassinat qui lui avait coûté la vie? Et Izek, celui qui est supposé tuer Rudbeckia dans le futur, se rangera-t-il aux côtés de son épouse?
description.it:
Nelle righe originali del romanzo, ero una malvagia, usata come strumento politico da mio padre e mio fratello maggiore, che finì per morire per mano del mio futuro marito. Per salvare il suo regno, mio padre pregò disperatamente Isaac di Omerta di sposarmi. Il problema è che l'uomo che dovrei sposare, il leggendario cavaliere del Nord, è lo stesso uomo che finirà per uccidere me e tutta la mia famiglia. Devo trovare un modo per sopravvivere! All'interno del romanzo stesso, ci sono molte sfide scoraggianti: devo trovare un modo per salvare la sorellina di mio marito, conquistare il mio freddo marito e ottenere il sostegno della gente del Nord, che attualmente mi disprezza. "Sono innamorata di lei!" Riuscirò nell'impresa?

---
In un romanzo, è diventata una malvagia che è morta tra le mani di suo marito. Per la precisione, come "attrice" non protagonista, una cattiva che muore dopo essere stata utilizzata come strumento per un matrimonio strategico da suo padre e suo fratello. Un giorno, il mio dannato padre ha strisciato e ha offerto la mia mano al mio quinto sposo. Il problema è che lui è proprio il marito che mi ucciderà e il miglior paladino del nord che in futuro distruggerà la mia famiglia. Per prima cosa, devo trovare un modo per sopravvivere. Nel romanzo ci sono molte difficoltà, come il freddo disprezzo di mio marito, l'odio e il bisogno di controllo dei nordisti e il disprezzo dei contadini, prima di trovare un modo per salvarmi la vita, dovrò risolvere diversi problemi. "Sono innamorata di te!" Quindi, per favore, salvami!
description.ko:
판타지 소설 속 남편의 손에 죽는
악역 조연, ‘루드베키아’가 되었다.

이 세계의 망할 아버지는 내 정략결혼 상대를 또 물어왔다.
문제는 그 상대가 바로 날 죽이게 될 남편이라는 것!

일단은 살길을 찾아야 한다.

북부 사람들에게 최대한 무해하게 보이면서
원작에서 내가 죽일 남편의 여동생도 지키고,
남편에겐 사랑에 빠진 척하면 목숨은 살려주지 않을까?

“전 당신한테 반해버렸어요!”

그러니까 제발 살려줘!
description.pt:
Me tornei ‘Rudbeckia’, uma coadjuvante em uma história de fantasia, uma vilã que morre pelas mãos de seu marido. O pior pai do mundo me achou outro parceiro para um casamento político. O problema é, essa pessoa é o marido que vai me matar! Primeiro, preciso achar uma forma para viver. Preciso parecer o mais inofensiva possível para o povo do norte e proteger a irmãzinha do meu marido que matei na história original. Não seria capaz de salvar minha vida se fingisse estar apaixonada pelo meu marido?

“Me apaixonei por você à primeira vista!”

“Então, por favor, me poupe!”
description.ru: Рудвекиа де Ворхиа является сикстинским ангелом и принцессой Романии, которой предначертано умереть от руки собственного мужа. После того как она стала обычным инструментом в руках верховного понтифика католической церкви и своего старшего брата, она вынуждена вступить в политический брак с лучшим паладином севера, который в будущем должен убить весь ее дом. Теперь девушка должна будет столкнуться с многочисленными трудностями, но ей придется приспособиться и выжить в новых условиях. Сначала ей придется доказать, что она не является опасностью для других людей, потому людям не стоит ее опасаться. Дальше же ей придется убедить всех людей в том, что она совершенно непричастна к делам понтифика и семьи.
description.tr: Kocasının ellerinde ölen bir kötü kadın karakterin bedenine reenkarne oldum. Daha doğrusu, babası ve erkek kardeşi tarafından siyasi evlilik aracı olarak kullanılırken ölen bir yardımcı karakter oldum. Bir gün, lanet olası babam gitti ve beşinci kocamı seçti. Sorun şu ki, seçilen kişi Kuzey'in en iyi Paladin'i, dahası gelecekte beni ve ailemi öldürecek olan kişiydi. Önce yaşamanın bir yolunu bulmalıyım. Romanda benim ellerimde ölecek olan biricik kız kardeşini kurtarmanın bir yolunu bulmadan önce aşmam gereken birçok zorluk var. Kocamın soğuk yüzünü eritmek, Kuzeyli'nin beğenisini kazanmak ve Dük'ün küçümsemesini yenmek gibi. Bu zorlukların üstesinden gelebilirsem, hayatım sonunda kurtulmuş olmaz mı? "Sana aşık oldum!" Bu yüzden lütfen beni bağışla!
description.uk: Вона стала злодійкою, яка померла від рук свого чоловіка в романі. Точніше, вона стала другорядною героїнею, яка померла, коли її батько і брат використовували як інструмент політичного шлюбу. По-перше, я маю знайти спосіб вижити у романі, знайти спосіб врятувати сестру мого чоловіка, яка в оригіналі померла від моїх рук, мені потрібно розтопити холодне серце мого чоловіка, завоювати прихильність населення та подолати презирство герцога. Якщо я зможу подолати ці труднощі, чи не буде моє життя врятовано пізніше? «Я закохався в тебе!» Тож будь ласка, пощади мене!
description.vi: Trong cuốn tiểu thuyết gốc, tôi là một nhân vật phản diện - người được cha và anh trai sử dụng như một công cụ chính trị và cũng là người hết dưới tay chồng tương lai của mình. Để cứu vương quốc, cha tôi đã tuyệt vọng cầu xin chú rể nắm lấy tay tôi và kết hôn. Vấn đề là người đàn ông mà tôi phải kết hôn chính là hiệp sĩ huyền thoại của phương Bắc và cũng là người đàn ông sẽ tiêu diệt tôi và cả gia đình. Tôi phải tìm cách tồn tại. Trong cuốn tiểu thuyết, có rất nhiều thử thách khó khăn dc đặt ra cho tôi: tôi phải tìm cách cứu em gái của chồng mình, giành dc trái tim của người chồng lạnh lùng và có dc sự ủng hộ của người dân phương Bắc và tất cả những người hiện tại coi thường tôi. "Em yêu anh!" Vì vậy, xin anh đừng giết em!!
description.zh: 我成为了在奇幻小说中死在丈夫手中的反派角色‘卢德薇基亚’。 更倒霉的是，父亲又给我找来了一个政治联姻的对象。 问题是，那个人就是要杀掉我的丈夫啊！ 首先要找到活路。 尽可能在北部人面前展示出无害的样子 还要保护在原著中死在我手下的丈夫的妹妹 假装对丈夫陷入爱河会不会挽救我的性命？ “我被你迷住了！” 所以拜托救救我吧！
description.zh-hk:
我成為了在奇幻小說中死在丈夫手中的反派角色‘盧德薇基亞’。

更倒霉的是，父親又給我找來了一個政治聯姻的對象。問題是，那個人就是要殺掉我的丈夫啊！首先要找到活路。

盡可能在北部人面前展示出無害的樣子 還要保護在原著中死在我手下的丈夫的妹妹

假裝對丈夫陷入愛河會不會挽救我的性命？ “我被你迷住了！” 所以拜託救救我吧！

description.en:
A weak and sickly boy, Sung Woo-mun's condition worsens when he loses his mental capacities, owing to a painting gifted by a sage. He grows up as the 'village idiot', pitied by his own parents. But unbeknownst to everyone, his life is about to change soon, and a new destiny awaits him. When Sung Woo-mun turns 20, not only does he have an epiphany, but an undefeatable martial arts power begins to bloom inside the painting. What could all of this mean for Woo Mun? And what strange world awaits him?

description.de:
Was ist gut daran, als Tochter des Herzogs wiedergeboren zu werden, wenn man die Schande der Familie ist? Während ihre Geschwister talentiert und wunderschön sind, wurde die arme Sylvia als fett und hässlich bezeichnet, mit einer berüchtigt schlechten Persönlichkeit obendrein. Sich daneben zu benehmen, um die Aufmerksamkeit ihres kalten Vaters zu bekommen, hat nur dazu geführt, dass sie von zu Hause verbannt wurde und ihr Leben in Verzweiflung endete. Aber als die neue „Sylvia“ fünf Jahre vor ihrem Tod aufwacht, könnte sie sich kaum weniger für die abfälligen Meinungen der anderen interessieren – sie wird dieses Leben auf ihre Weise leben! In einer Welt voller Dämonen und Diebe muss sie alle verfügbaren Ressourcen nutzen und sich darauf vorbereiten, alleine zu überleben. Sobald sie so weit ist, wird sie sich von ihrer Familien und den Fieslingen verabschieden ... also warum fangen plötzlich alle Leute, die sich vorher nie um sie gekümmert haben, an, sich für sie zu interessieren?

description.en:
Of all things, I possessed an ugly noble lady.

For the sake of receiving the attention of those who despised her, Sylvia Atlante, in the midst of all the ridicule and disrespect, made herself known as the “ugly lady”. However, one day, I happened to possess Sylvia’s body, who drank poison and ended her own life. I didn’t want to live like her.

“I’m rich and healthy, so why do I need to care about other people? This is my life, I’m going to live as I want!”

I just wanted to live a quiet life, but…

“Still, you’re my little sister, and you’re part of the Atlante family.”

The family’s a little strange.

“I’m interested in you, not your younger sister.”

“You must take responsibility for this body until the end. That’s the job of the contractor.”

“I, Theve Hiddleton, swear to be the sword of Sylvia Atlante and devote everything to her.”

“I won’t bother you. So please, keep me by your side!”

“There’s nothing in this world I can’t find. So don’t even try to run away from me.”

The handsome guys who I thought I’d never get involved with stuck around. What’s wrong with everyone? Isn’t this too different from Sylvia’s memory? I just wanted to live a peaceful life?!

---
What good is being reborn as the duke's daughter when you're the shame of the family? While her siblings were talented and beautiful, poor Sylvia was called fat and ugly, with a rumored bad personality to boot. Acting out for her cold father's attention only got her exiled from home and made her take her own life. But when the new "Sylvia" wakes up five years before her death, she could care less about the snarky opinions of others–she'll live this life her own way. In a world crawling with demons and thieves, she must use all the resources at her fingertips and prepare to survive on her own. Once she does, it's goodbye to her family and the naysayers... so why are the people who never cared about her before starting to take an interest in her?

description.fr:
Quel intérêt de me réincarner dans le corps de la fille du duc si c'est pour que tout le monde me déteste?! Tandis que ses frères et sœurs étaient adorés de tous pour leur beauté et leur gentillesse, Sylvia, elle, subissait de lourdes moqueries à cause de son apparence et des rumeurs sur son affreuse personnalité. Après avoir tenté plus d'une fois d'obtenir l'attention de son père, elle a fini par ne s'attirer que des problèmes et s'ôter la vie par désespoir... Et me voilà maintenant dans son corps, cinq ans avant ce tragique incident, et je ne compte pas laisser la situation telle quelle. Je me fiche de ce que pensent les autres, je compte bien me faire une place dans ce monde rempli de difficultés, de dangers et de magie. Maintenant, j'aimerais juste savoir pourquoi, alors que je ne cherche plus à avoir l'attention de qui que ce soit, tout le monde semble soudainement s'intéresser à Sylvia...?

description.tr:
Her şeyden önce çirkin, asil bir bayanın bedenine reenkarne oldum.

Onu küçümseyenlerin dikkatini çekmek uğruna Sylvia Atlante, tüm alay ve saygısızlığın ortasında kendisini “çirkin leydin” olarak tanıttı.

Ancak bir gün, zehir içen ve kendi hayatına son veren Sylvia’nın vücuduna reenkarne oldum. Lakin onun gibi yaşamak istemiyordum.

“Zengin ve sağlıklıyım, öyleyse neden diğer insanları önemsemem gerekiyor? Bu benim hayatım, istediğim gibi yaşayacağım!”

Sadece sessiz bir hayat yaşamak istemiştim fakat…

Yine de, sen benim küçük kardeşimsin ve sen Atlante ailesinin bir parçasısın.

Bu aile biraz tuhaf.

“Seninle ilgileniyorum, küçük kız kardeşinle değil.”

“Sonuna kadar bu bedenin sorumluluğunu almalısın. Yüklenicinin işi bu.”

“Ben, Theve Hiddleton, Sylvia Atlante’nin kılıcı olmaya yemin ederim ve her şeyi ona adıyorum.”

“Sizi hiçbir zaman rahatsız etmeyeceğim. Bu yüzden lütfen beni yanınızda tutun!”

“Bu dünyada bulamadığım hiçbir şey yok. Dolayısıyla sakın benden kaçayım bile deme”

Asla temas halinde bulunamayacağımı düşündüğüm yakışıklı adamlar etrafımda dönüp duruyorlar.

Herkesin nesi var böyle? Bu Sylvia’nın yaşadıklarından çok farklı değil mi? Yoksa sadece huzurlu bir hayat yaşamak istediğim için olabilir mi?!

description.fr:
La voie des rêves ouvre bien des portes! Elle est la Reine d'Argent, une demi-déesse, la future Impératrice. Mais au sein du palais, son existence a toujours été épargnée de la dure réalité de l'extérieur. A l'aube de sa majorité, elle commence à rêver, chose pourtant impossible pour un demi-dieu. Que signifie ces visions soudaines? Sa rencontre avec un mystérieux épéiste va-t-elle changer sa vision du monde?

description.ko:
제국의 유일한 황녀 시에나 아르젠트 그녀는 태어나면서부터 모든 것을 가졌다. 영민한 두뇌, 극상의 미모, 우월한 재능. 장차 황제의 관을 쓸 후계자의 지위까지. 스무 살의 생일을 앞둔 어느 날. 그녀는 꿈을 꾸기 시작하며 수십 년 후 자신의 미래를 보게 되는데. 그녀는 신의 축복으로 예지 능력을 갖게 되었다고 기뻐하며 신께 감사한다. 하지만 꿈에서 보는 자신의 미래는 갈수록 이상하다. 시에나가 막연히 그렸던 미래는 이런 것이 아니었다. 반쪽 핏줄이라고 경멸했던 이복 오라버니의 반격. 자신의 절대적 아군으로 믿었던 어머니의 숨겨진 모습. 그리고 현실과 미래, 양쪽에서 시에나에게 막강한 영향을 미치는 남자의 등장. 그녀 주변의 모든 것이 급격히 달라지기 시작하고 그녀 또한 변화한다.

description.pt:
A única princesa do Império, Sienna Argent, tem tudo de nascença: inteligência, beleza, talento e até mesmo o direito de ser a herdeira do império.Em seu 20º aniversário, ela começa a ter sonhos com seu futuro. Ela agradece aos Deuses por esse poder, mas então seus sonhos se tornam muito estranhos, representando um futuro que não era o que ela sonhou.Um ataque de seu meio irmão que ela desprezava, um lado oculto de sua mãe que ela acreditava ser sua aliada, um homem que começou a influenciar ambas as vidas de Siena, no futuro e no presente. A medida que o ambiente muda, ela passa a mudar também.

The protagonist, an egocentric man who's led a successful life as the CEO of a company in modern society is murdered and reborn as a beautiful lady named Paril Hall Mcgryued from a noble family in a fantasy world. description.pt: Em uma sociedade onde aparência significa tudo, Park Hyumg Suk, pequeno, gordo e não atraente, sofre bullying diariamente, mas nunca falou a sua mãe super trabalhadeira sobre isso. Um dia, quando sua mãe o vê sofrendo bullying, ela o envia para uma escola melhor. Mas infelizmente, ele descobre que sua nova escola é tão cruel quanto a anterior. Uma noite, ele acorda e descobre que de repente ficou alto, forte e incrivelmente bonito. Quando volta para a cama e encontra o seu corpo antigo corpo dormindo. Ele agora tem uma mente e dois corpos. Toda vez que um dorme, o outro corpo acorda, e toda vez que um acorda o outro dorme. Com medo de sofrer bullying novamente na nova escola, ele decide usar o seu novo corpo para ir à escola. Mas como será isso? Será que ele finalmente será aceito?

Це дає йому можливість прожити подвійне життя: в одному тілі він залишається непривабливим і слабким, а в іншому – стає популярним і успішним.

description.de: Die böse Zauberin Fiona Green sollte eigentlich durch das Protagonistenpaar in "Der Kaiser und die Heilige" sterben. Doch dann wurde die Autorin der Geschichte selbst zu Fiona! Misshandelt und von ihrer arrogant elitären Familie verstoßen, findet sie sich plötzlich in der Schlacht von Haylon wieder und ist fest entschlossen, ihre Magie nun für das Gute einzusetzen. Doch alles nimmt eine unerwartete Wendung, als sie den männlichen Hauptcharakter Sigren rettet und ihn vom Feind zum Verbündeten macht… Wird es ihr gelingen, ihr Schicksal zu verändern?
description.en:
In the novel *The Emperor and the Saintess*, the male lead and heroine were able to defeat the cursed dragons and the demons, as well as the final boss of the story, with their beautiful love.

"...Haha. I'd rather die now, so I can go in peace."

Rather than having a brilliant future and being hailed as a genius mage, I just want a secure future where I can have a comfortable retirement... That's what I wish, but when this world comes to an end, I'm the final boss. Please, just let me live... However, "Wait, isn't this the male lead, Siegren? Why is he here?"

Siegren, the heroic male lead who will save the world, is dying right in front of my eyes? The male lead whose mind and body where all tattered from rolling around in the battlefield.

"Siegren, I'm sure you'll have many things to do in the future. I promise to help you achieve that."

When I saw Siegren's wounds, I made a promise. This person, who suffered because of the lines I wrote. I promise to bring him happiness, a brilliant future, and a comfortable life.
___
Evil mage Fiona Green was destined to die at the hands of the protagonist couple in *The Emperor and the Saint*. That is until the story’s author became Fiona herself! Though mistreated, cast out by her pompous family, and thrown into the battle at Heylon, Fiona is determined to use her magic for good. But things take a rather unexpected turn when she rescues the male lead, Siegren, turning him from foe to friend… Will she successfully rewrite her fate without changing the story’s happy ending?
description.fr: Se retrouver coincée dans le corps de la méchante que l'on a créée, quelle ironie pour une romancière à succès! Il va pourtant falloir s'accommoder de la situation, même si le passé de la terrible mage Fiona Green n'est pas réjouissant. Née bâtarde, sa famille n'hésite pas à l'envoyer se battre seule contre des monstres à 13 ans. Mais la nouvelle Fiona ne pourrait-elle pas mettre à profit ses connaissances des rouages de l'histoire pour changer le cours des évènements?

제발 살려만 줘라…….
그런데,

description.ru: Я попала в тело Фионы, главной злодейки, чья душа была приговорена к вечным страданиям после ужасной кончины от рук главного героя. Её семья издевалась над ней только потому, что она была незаконнорожденной. И вот, переселившись в тело за 6 лет до начала романа, меня отправили на войну в возрасте 13 лет! К счастью, Фиона как главная злодейка романа оказалась гениальным магом. Я должна пережить нашествие монстров, но сейчас не могу находиться в центре поля боя. Как раз перед тем как я выдохлась, я столкнулась с главным героем-подростком. …Почему он здесь? Что ж, если главный герой здесь умрёт, то мир будет разрушен. Так что давайте сначала спасём его!
description.tr: "İmparator ve Azize" romanında erkek başrol ve kadın başrol, lanetli ejderhaları, iblisleri ve hikâyenin son düşmanını güzel aşklarıyla yenmeyi başardı. "...Haha. Şimdi ölmeyi tercih ederim, böylece huzurla gidebilirim." Parlak bir geleceğe sahip dahi bir büyücü olarak yaşamak yerine, rahat bir emeklilik hayatı sürdürebileceğim güvenli bir gelecek istiyorum... Tek dileğim buydu fakat bu dünyanın sonu geldiğinde, son ve en güçlü düşman ben olacağım. Lütfen, sadece yaşamama izin verin... Ancak, "Bir dakika, bu erkek başrol Siegren değil mi?" "O neden burada?" Dünyayı kurtaracak kahraman erkek başrol Siegren gözlerimin önünde mi ölüyor? Savaş alanında hırpalanmaktan aklı ve vücudu parçalanan bir erkek başrol. "Siegren, eminim gelecekte yapacak çok şeyin olacak." "Bunu başarmana yardım edeceğime söz veriyorum." Siegren'ın yaralarını gördüğümde bir söz verdim. 'Yazdığım satırlar yüzünden acı çeken bu kişiye; mutluluk, parlak bir gelecek ve rahat bir hayat getireceğime söz veriyorum.'
description.uk:
Я потрапила у тіло головної лиходійки, що приречена на смерть і вічні страждання душі. Її сім’я знущалась з неї лишень тому, що вона була позашлюбною дочкою графа.
І ось, перемістившись в тіло задовго до початку роману, мене відправили на війну. На щастя, я стану геніальним магом. Переживши основну навалу монстрів, я зіткнулась із головним героєм. 
Чому він тут? Якщо головний герой помре, то світ буде зруйновано. Врятуймо його!
description.pt-br: Possuí o corpo de ‘Fiona’, a vilã final que teve sua alma sentenciada ao sofrimento eterno depois de sua morte horrível nas mãos do herói do mundo. Ela foi torturada por sua própria família apenas porque era uma criança ilegítima. E então… Chegando seis anos antes do começo da história, fui enviada para a guerra com treze anos de idade! Por sorte, como a grande vilã da história, Fiona é uma feiticeira genial. Preciso sobreviver à invasão dos monstros, mas agora não consigo ir para o meio do campo de batalha. Antes de perder todo o fôlego, encontrei o protagonista em sua adolescência. Por que ele está aqui…? Bem, se o protagonista morrer aqui, o mundo será destruído. Então, vamos salvá-lo primeiro!

description.en:
When I first came into the book, my goal was just to survive.

‘I have to live longer! And be happy!’ So I did my best.

I am going to walk on my own flower path.

“Wherever I go, the seat next to you is mine. You promised to pat my head for the rest of your life, isn’t that right?” The strongest male character, who was stabbed to death in the original novel, stared at me with obsessive eyes.

If I say no, he will destroy the world.

“Yes, I’ll kill him. Then you’ll be happy, too, right?” The fifth brother looked a bit crazy.

“This is my land from here to here. And yours, too. I’m glad to be able to breathe with your grandest dreams.” The fourth oldest sister, who became the richest woman on the continent, opened the map and said that.

If I say I don’t have such a grand dream like her, I think a catastrophe will happen.

“I’m looking forward to the Winter Solstice that you’ll rule completely.” Laughter rose on the face of the butler who served me.

“If you don’t connect to Verratoux, my heart will stop tomorrow morning. Are you sure you’re okay with that?” My first sister, who was supposed to be the original successor, threatened me with her life.

And this is the biggest problem. Somehow, a faint smile raised my father’s mouth, which became stronger than the original father he was. “Independence? Try it then. I won’t even let a single ant live on this land.”

“Did you think you could leave my arms and stand on your own…” He then stared at me obsessively.

They are all acting weird.

Everything went wrong.

I only did my very best.
